equality: Whitespace and quote normalization; rem/px equality assumes a 16px root; s/ms normalize to ms; simple calc(a / b) line-height ratios evaluate numerically; em is not rem. Variable aliases resolve from root. Counterpart arrays contain the complete named theme scale, and equal marks exact normalized values. Spacing maps to exact --spacing multiples. Counts are boundary-delimited literal occurrences in declaration values and at-rule parameters, excluding selectors and comments.
